'''Grungie''' was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who attempted to break into [[Pandor's Hydrospanner (Ord Mynock)|Pandor's Hydrospanner]] on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. He fell victim to a [[Vindicator Lockjaw]] [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droid]] guarding the establishment.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
